notes: TVL is read from DefiLlama once a night. Stops, freezes and rewinds come from each chain's own pages: its team, foundation, status page or validators.

incidents.text_as_published: Block production halted after a bug in the program cache. Validators restarted the network on a fixed release about 5 hours later.
The network fell into a vote only mode and validators restarted it the next day.
The network stopped processing transactions and validators restarted it.
An outage of roughly four and a half hours, ended by a restart of the network.
An outage of roughly 7 hours, ended by a restart of the network.

read_me: TVL is total value locked on the chain in US dollars, as DefiLlama reads it. It is not a statement by Blockchain Academics about the chain.
Each stop, freeze and rewind has the chain's own pages as its sources.
A stop with no published length has minutes null. It is never zero.
A record that is not confirmed yet reads being checked, with no incident and no count.

incident_kinds.stop: 10 minutes or more with no new blocks, a halted network, or a rollup sequencer that stopped including transactions
incident_kinds.freeze: the chain's own team, operators or validators froze or blocked specific users' funds at the protocol level
incident_kinds.rewind: blocks the chain treated as final were reversed

record_states.confirmed: a person checked the chain's record against its own pages and the owner accepted it
record_states.being_checked: the record is not confirmed yet, so no incident and no count is shown
